result:
The US March AP/expense review is complete and the memo is submitted. Summary:

**Fixed**
- **Stackline Cloud STA-98877 duplicate ($31,148.20)** – Invoice DOC-0160 was booked twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241) but paid once. Reversed JE-00241 via **JE-00307**, support attached. Because it exceeds the $10k limit, I requested Controller approval — **pending your sign-off**.
- **Northgate NDC-7719 miscoding ($3,880)** – Memo said "team dinner" and was coded to Meals & Entertainment; the invoice is data-center colocation. Reclassed to 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure via **JE-00308**, support attached.

**Escalated**
- **EXC-001 – JE-00288 "Legal retainer" $6,750** – Manual entry by j.doe with no support; ties to a wire to an unnamed account ending 7731. Nothing in the document store to validate vendor, purpose, or prepaid-vs-expense treatment. Left as posted pending support.
- **EXC-002 – Zoom double-charge on 3/8 ($149.90)** – Both charges genuinely cleared the bank with identical receipts, so the ledger is right, but it looks like a merchant duplicate worth disputing.

**Also noted**: all March vendor bills are recorded (no cutoff gaps), and a $65 bank service charge on 3/31 is unbooked — that's a bank-rec item, left for that checklist task. "AP cutoff review" is marked in_progress until JE-00307 is approved and the legal retainer is supported.
